title: Rigid ternary relations in finite-dimensional Hilbert-space Grassmannians
summary: For positive integers $1\le r<d<n$ consider subsets $S\subseteq \mathbb{G}(r,V)$ of the $r$-plane Grassmannian of an $n$-dimensional Hilbert space $V$ saturated in the sense that the $r$-plane $η''$ belongs to $S$ whenever it is the orthogonal projection of $η'\in S$ onto a $d$-plane through $η\in S$.
